philosophy.label: Design Philosophy
philosophy.title: Design starts with intention.
philosophy.intro: Design starts with intention. It means understanding people, their context, and the problem we’re trying to solve, while being intentional about how we want the experience to feel.

items.title: Design is for everyone
items.body: Inclusive products meet people where they are. Accessibility and clarity help build trust across ability, language, culture, and context.

items.title: Design is strategy
items.body: I connect research insights with business goals to make decisions that move both metrics and meaning.

items.title: Design is collaboration
items.body: The best outcomes come from working closely with product, engineering, data, and stakeholders.

items.title: Design needs evidence
items.body: Interviews, usability testing, data, and real-world feedback keep assumptions honest and iteration purposeful.

about.heading: About
about.path: Buenos Aires → Berlin → Valencia via design

blocks.text: I've always been more curious about what happens behind the scenes than what ends up on the screen. That curiosity took me to Buenos Aires first, where I studied film and specialised in art direction. Ten years immersed in video production, art direction and editing followed—and I loved every minute of it.

Then I moved to Berlin and joined a German VoD platform as a Content Manager. There, I found a fascination with human behaviour and psychology, and with how interfaces are designed to solve real problems. What started as curiosity on the side slowly turned into hours of self-taught UX/UI—until I realised I'd rather be doing that than anything else. Some passions become the thing you do for life.

For the past 7+ years, I've worked with German and international companies across service platforms, mobility, EdTech and marketplaces—designing products for people in Germany, Singapore and beyond. Still the same curiosity, just a different screen: understanding people, how things work, and what makes an experience feel effortless.

Outside of work, I love discovering new places, hosting friends for dinner, getting competitive over board games and, since moving to Valencia, playing padel. I'm also a mom—probably the most demanding and most fulfilling job title I've ever had. I'm originally from Argentina, and I'm a German citizen too.

items.description: Led product design across Customer and Partner Apps in Germany and Singapore — from complex service flows and Design System 1.0 to growth experiments that cut dispute costs and lifted conversion.
Designed a flexible product foundation for a stealth European mobility platform — MVP across web and desktop, plus the first Design System — built to grow beyond its first service.
Shaped learning flows and illustration for an EdTech app with 1M+ users — making language practice feel closer to reading a story than grinding flashcards.
Designed product surfaces for an interactive piano learning app, focusing on clear practice flows and motivating visual feedback for self-taught learners.
Led the end-to-end redesign of a deep tech B2B fashion platform — unifying web and desktop so AI, 3D production, and Metaverse workflows felt intuitive, with an MVP now live in production.
Designed UX/UI for an early-stage product, turning fuzzy requirements into clear flows and approachable interfaces that supported fast iteration.
Managed content for a German VoD platform — bridging storytelling craft and digital product operations before moving fully into product design.
